metadata.name: L.R.R.H.3.0
metadata.description: This is a fabulous tale about the sweet Little Red Riding Hood in the 21st century.

metadata.name: L.R.R.H.3.0 - 1
metadata.description: Once upon a time, in a small town not far away, there lived a beautiful girl named Little Red Riding Hood. She was head over heels for the one and only rock god Mr Wolf DeGrey. Crushing on a rock star is a rite of passage for young girls.

metadata.name: L.R.R.H.3.0 - 2
metadata.description: One day she found out that Wolf was coming to her little town.  Over breakfast, which was, obviously, coffee and cigarettes, she told her mom the big news. Mom, hidden behind her black sunglasses, rolled her eyes, took a drag and said, - Why don't you go visit Grandma, darling?

metadata.name: L.R.R.H.3.0 - 3
metadata.description: Sipping a mimosa, she packed Little Red Riding Hood for the journey.

metadata.name: L.R.R.H.3.0 - 4
metadata.description: Little Red met Mr Wolf. It wasn't easy (good things dont come easy, do they?);- Hey babe, wanna have some fun? asked Wolf. The girl replied without skipping a bit - I'd love to, but a hotels off-limits. But, Grandma's chill about young folks and their needs. So, if Mr Wolfs OK with swinging by Grandmas, shed join him there later. Mr Wolf sped off faster than Little Red could blink - he had a car, after all. And also because he just wanted her so badly.

metadata.name: L.R.R.H.3.0 - 5
metadata.description: Little Red's Grandma is a sweet old lady 'with a past.' She said, 'I get it, darling,' and was more than willing to step out for the sake of young love.

metadata.name: Hringaz
metadata.description: The artwork "Hringaz" is produced through an automatic stream of consciousness. The point of origin for this method comes from a Zen Buddhist-like practice that reinforces the hand and will of mind towards a sense of the sublime. The books were created in a single sitting, which was necessary to induce a flow-state that could invoke and produce a purely subconscious art.

metadata.name: L.R.R.H.3.0 - 6
metadata.description: Next thing you know, they found themselves in bed, with Little Red talking to Wolf about his big ears... and other big things.

metadata.name: L.R.R.H.3.0 - 7
metadata.description: And everything would've been just fine if, about half an hour later, these three heroes had not filed sexual assault charges against Mr Wolf. Ladies came, all dressed up, wearing their best wolf fur. This was a wonderful family of hutresses.

metadata.title: A flower landscape with a sky full of HAHA

metadata.name: L.R.R.H.3.0 - 8
metadata.description: Wolf found himself behind bars, bail denied. Mom and Grandma made sure of that.  Little Red visited him in jail, confessing her undying love. 'Marry me, and I'll find a way to get you out' - she said. Wolf said yes.

metadata.name: L.R.R.H.3.0 - 9
metadata.description: Little Red was so much fun that despite the awkwardness, Wolf could not resist his fiancee's charm and wit.  Come wedding day, she was pretty pregnant.

metadata.name: L.R.R.H.3.0 -  10
metadata.description: Fast forward a few years, and Little Red took Wolf to the cleaners in the divorce.  Wolf was no angel, after all. He was a wolf. But Little Red walked away from this marriage with not just a wolf fur coat.  They had two beautiful kids - a boy and a girl.  The boy looked exactly like Mr Wolf, and the girl looked more like her mother. But she still howled at the moon when it was round.

metadata.name: L.R.R.H.3.0 - 11
metadata.description:
That's the end of this story, folks. 

Everyone lived happily ever after, sometimes apart, sometimes together.

Embarking on a journey of discovery, I revel in my multifaceted nature, delving into the profound depths of ancient knowledge and wisdom. In the vastness of my interests and endeavours, I delight in casting spells of goodwill upon those who traverse the mystical realms alongside me. Together, we intertwine, exploring the magical wonders that unfold in our shared cosmic journey

My experiment involved building a synthetic wormhole used for instant cosmic data transmission. My apparatus was designed to aid the search for extraterrestrial life in the cosmos, among other things. During my final experiment, I was drawn into the black hole. I faced cosmic disintegration, emerging intertwined with unknown cosmic materials. I now exist in the form of many recursive entities simultaneously, cursed by my own curiosity. metadata.name: LOONG
metadata.desc: In the dawn of 2024 the year of the dragon , a colossal, powerful and fierce dragon named Loong born of code and fire and emerged from the depths as a new ordinal in CBRC-20. This cybernetic beast, fueled by algorithms and virtual flames,soaring through the skies with scales that shimmered like precious gemstones, sought dominion and casting its digital shadow across the blockchain landscape.
metadata.purpose: Upon reaching the heart of the CBRC-20, adventurers discovered that Loong was not just a guardian but a harbinger of innovation. His fiery breath held the power to ignite new blockchain projects and technologies that would shape the future of decentralized ecosystems. United in their quest for knowledge and progress, the adventurers formed a decentralized alliance, pledging to collaborate and explore the uncharted territories of the blockchain realm. The dragon, Loong, became a symbol of inspiration, encouraging the world to embrace the transformative power of decentralized technologies. And so, in the year of the dragon, 2024, Loong's legacy lived on in the hearts and codes of those who dared to dream of a decentralized future, where the power of the blockchain soared as high as the dragon himself.
